detail: N.J.S.A. 17B:17-3 says life insurance includes provisions for additional benefits for death by accident or for dismemberment, whether they are in the policy or in a supplemental contract. Standalone AD&D is usually classed as accident and health, but the stem names the New Jersey definition of life insurance and the benefit is attached to a life policy, so A does not hold up.

Saying 'definition of life insurance' in the stem points a little toward D, but it is not a strong cue. A (health) is a tempting distractor because AD&D is often thought of as accident/health coverage.
